description: List the individual metrics, among them the Fed balance sheet, M2 supply, Treasury yields, net liquidity, the dollar, cross-asset indices (SPY, QQQ, VXX, UUP) and Bitcoin price and hash rate. Use it to find a metric's name for get_metric; for a reasoned view across several series, use list_briefings. Filter by category or by a search word. No authentication required.

category.description: Filter by metric category: bitcoin, calculated, eth, macro

search.description: Search term to filter metrics by name or description
